messages:
evan: quick check-in: we need a cross-lang decision on how retries behave for paginated vs streaming endpoints. want to avoid surprises for customers who use iterate helpers and expect dedupe.
carmen: tl;dr: expose retry_scope (call|page|stream) at call site; generator annotations should mark pagination type so SDKs pick sane defaults.
joel: important: offset pagination + page retries = duplicate items. add strong warnings in docs and default to call-level retry for offset endpoints.
patrick: streaming: don't retry chunks. default retry_scope=none for streams, and instead surface reconnect+resume helper when server supports resume-token.
evans: small runtime shim suggestion: transport provides RetryContext {scope, attempts, allow_reorder}. SDK maps user options to that. keep public surface tiny: Retry(max_attempts=2, scope='page').
carmen: sample usage: TS: client.listFoo({pageSize:50}, {retry:{maxAttempts:2, retry_scope:'page'}})  Go: client.ListFoo(ctx, opts, WithRetry(Policy{Max:2, Scope:Page}))  Py: client.list_foo(page_size=50, retry=Retry(max_attempts=2, scope='page'))
joel: codegen flags: x-sdk-pagination: cursor|offset|none and x-sdk-default-retry-scope: page|call|none. That lets us default and still allow per-call override.
patrick: also add iterate_all helper in SDKs that uses resume tokens and optional dedupe when pagination is cursor-based. For offset-based pagination the helper should emit a warning and require explicit de-dup opt-in.
evans: telemetry: tag retry_scope on retry metrics so Console can break down cost by page vs call retries.
carmen: action items: add generator annotations, implement RetryContext shim, docs + examples per language, iterate_all helper, telemetry tagging. no objections?
joel: none. i'll add a short RFC paragraph and include generator sample.
build-bot: ACTIONS created: RFC -> joel, SDK examples -> carmen, go prototype -> patrick. due in 5 business days. (link: https://rfc.internal/789) :gear:
